Mitigation / control: Authenticate users, enforce simultaneous-user and download limits per licence, detect bulk downloading and keep usage statistics.; Policy parameters configurable per member category; overrides authorised and logged with reason.

Mitigation / control: Design and test to WCAG 2.1 AA, including screen-reader and keyboard-only testing.

Mitigation / control: Single sign-on or multi-factor authentication for staff, session timeout, input validation and secure API design.; Role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, access logging, and an incident-reporting procedure.

Description: No requirement covers 'Consent and notice' required by Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Mitigation / control: The system shall record each member's consent and the purpose for which personal data is collected, and display a privacy notice at registration.

Description: No requirement covers 'Retention and deletion' required by Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Mitigation / control: The system shall retain borrowing history only for the institution-approved retention period and then delete or anonymise it.

Description: No requirement covers 'Data-subject rights' required by Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Mitigation / control: The system shall let members request access to, correction of, or erasure of their personal data, with each request logged.

Description: No requirement covers 'Role-based access control' required by Information Technology Act, 2000 and institutional IT security policy.
Mitigation / control: The system shall enforce role-based access control so each staff and member role can access only the functions and data it needs.

Description: No requirement covers 'Encryption' required by Information Technology Act, 2000 and institutional IT security policy.
Mitigation / control: The system shall encrypt personal and transaction data in transit and at rest.

Description: No requirement covers 'Embargo handling' required by Institutional repository and open-access policy (UGC ETD regulations).
Mitigation / control: The system shall support embargo periods on deposited theses and release them automatically on the approved date.

Description: No requirement covers 'Descriptive metadata' required by Institutional repository and open-access policy (UGC ETD regulations).
Mitigation / control: The system shall capture Dublin Core metadata for every deposited item.

Description: No requirement covers 'Evidence export' required by Accreditation and ranking data requirements (NAAC / NBA / NIRF).
Mitigation / control: The system shall export accreditation reports by academic year in CSV and PDF with drill-down to source records.

Description: No requirement covers 'Configurable policy parameters' required by Institutional lending and fines policy (placeholder).
Mitigation / control: The system shall let an authorised administrator configure loan period, borrowing limit and fine rate per member category.

Description: No requirement covers 'Backup and recovery' required by Institutional records retention and audit policy (placeholder).
Mitigation / control: The system shall back up data daily and support recovery within the institution-approved RTO and RPO.
